```{r}
final_data_rand_cses <- readRDS("D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/R00/Manuscripts/HRS/Stress sensitization/Data/final_data_rand_cses_new.rds")
```



```{r}
#convert values from 5 and 1 to 0 and 1 
binary_cols <- names(final_data_rand_cses)[
  sapply(final_data_rand_cses, function(x) {
    all(na.omit(unique(x)) %in% c(1, 5))
  })
]

```



```{r}
final_data_rand_cses <- final_data_rand_cses %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(binary_cols), ~ case_when(
    .x == 5 ~ 0,
    .x == 1 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )))
```




```{r}
#create first wordtot variable
final_data_rand_cses$first_wordtot <- apply(
  final_data_rand_cses[, grep("^wordtot", names(final_data_rand_cses))], 
  1,                                
  function(x) na.omit(x)[1]   
)
```




```{r}
suffix_replace <- c(
  "037a" = "_child_died",
  "037b" = "_major_disaster",
  "037c" = "_fire_weapon",
  "037d" = "_sp_drugs",
  "037e" = "_physical_attack",
  "037f" = "_illness",
  "037g" = "_life_threatening"
)


for (pattern in names(suffix_replace)) {
  cols_to_rename <- grep(pattern, names(final_data_rand_cses), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols_to_rename) > 0) {
    new_names <- gsub(pattern, suffix_replace[pattern], cols_to_rename)
    names(final_data_rand_cses)[names(final_data_rand_cses) %in% cols_to_rename] <- new_names
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Imputations for 0610

length(imp.vars0610)
```




```{r}
#Set variable types
continuous.vars_0610<-c("cses_index","first_wordtot","baseline_age","raedyrs")

binary.vars_0610 <- c(
  "police", "parent_drugs", "parent_abuse",
  grep("^mlb", names(final_data_rand_cses), value = TRUE),
  "orphanage", "fosterhome", "parent_divorce", "parent_died","ragenderf", "bornsouth"
)


ordinal.vars_0610<-c("srh")

categorical.vars_0610<-c("raracemf","pedu_cat","maristat")
```





```{r}
#Check that have all variables, no duplicates
length(c(continuous.vars_0610, binary.vars_0610, ordinal.vars_0610, categorical.vars_0610)) #24

sum(duplicated(c(continuous.vars_0610, binary.vars_0610, ordinal.vars_0610, categorical.vars_0610))) #0  
```




```{r}
#Set variable classes by type
for (i in binary.vars_0610){
  in.0610.data[,i]<-factor(in.0610.data[,i])}
for (i in ordinal.vars_0610){
  in.0610.data[,i]<-factor(in.0610.data[,i], ordered=T)}
for (i in categorical.vars_0610){
  in.0610.data[,i]<-factor(in.0610.data[,i], ordered=FALSE)}
```





```{r}
#recheck classes
classsum<-data.frame(varname=imp.vars0610, class=NA)
for (i in imp.vars0610){
  classsum[classsum$varname==i,"class"]<-(class(in.0610.data[,i])[1])
}
classsum
```






```{r}
#Initiate imputations
ini<-mice(in.0610.data, maxit=0, defaultMethod = c("pmm", "pmm", "pmm", "pmm"), seed=12345)
  
ini$method
meth<-ini$method
meth
  
ini$predictorMatrix
pred<-ini$predictorMatrix
```





```{r}
#Run imputations
imp_pmm_all.0610<-mice(in.0610.data, m=40, maxit=10, pred=pred, meth=meth, 
                  defaultMethod = c("pmm", "pmm", "pmm", "pmm"), seed=12345)
```


```{r}
#examine diagnostics
imp_pmm_all.0610$loggedEvents
plot(imp_pmm_all.0610)
```



```{r}
#Save final imputed datasets
temp_base0610i<-list()
for (i in 1:40){
  temp_base0610i[[i]]<-complete(imp_pmm_all.0610,action=i)
    
  temp_base0610i[[i]]<-cbind(base0610i$hhidpn, temp_base0610i[[i]][,imputation.vars_0610])
  temp_base0610i[[i]][,"imp"]<-i
}
  
cohort0610_final <-do.call(rbind,temp_base0610i)
```

```{r}
cols_to_merge <- c("hhidpn", "baseline_year",
                   "age06", "age08", "age10", "age12", "age14", "age16", "age18", "age20",
                   "wordtot10", "wordtot12", "wordtot14", "wordtot16", "wordtot18", "wordtot20")
```


```{r}
#CFA
ACE_vars<- c("police", "parent_drugs", "parent_abuse", "orphanage", "fosterhome", "parent_divorce")

test_wordtot_data <- final_cohort[complete.cases(final_cohort[, ACE_vars]), ]


```


```{r}
wordtot_mod2<-'aces =~ police + parent_drugs + parent_abuse + orphanage + 
                      fosterhome + parent_divorce
                      
                      orphanage ~~ fosterhome'


ACE_wordtot_CFA2_test <- cfa(wordtot_mod2, data=test_wordtot_data, ordered=ACE_vars)
summary(ACE_wordtot_CFA2_test, fit.measures=T, standardized=T)
#CFI =0.991(>0.9) RMSEA = 0.017(<0.08)
#All vars load
```


```{r}

imp_list <- unique(test_wordtot_data$imp)
all_scores <- data.frame()
for (i in imp_list) {
  
  wordtot_mod2<-'aces =~ police + parent_drugs + parent_abuse + orphanage + 
                      fosterhome + parent_divorce
                      
                      orphanage ~~ fosterhome'
  
  test_wordtot_data_imp <- test_wordtot_data %>% 
    filter(imp == i) 
  
  ACE_wordtot_CFA2_test <- cfa(wordtot_mod2, data = test_wordtot_data_imp, ordered = ACE_vars)
  
  factor_score <- lavPredict(ACE_wordtot_CFA2_test)
  
  df_scores <- data.frame(
    hhidpn = test_wordtot_data_imp$hhidpn,
    imp = i,
    aces = factor_score
  )
  all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, df_scores) 
}



```

```{r}
#add cut point
imp_list_all <- unique(test_wordtot_data$imp)
cutpoint_df <- data.frame()

for (i in imp_list_all) {
  
  final_cohort_i <- final_cohort %>%
    filter(imp == i) %>%
    select(hhidpn, imp, all_of(ACE_vars))
  
  scores_i <- all_scores %>%
    filter(imp == i)
  
  merged_i <- final_cohort_i %>%
    inner_join(scores_i, by = c("hhidpn", "imp"))
  
  cutpoint_i <- merged_i %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(ACE_vars), ~ .x == 0)) %>%
    pull(aces) %>%
    unique()
  
  cutpoint_df <- rbind(cutpoint_df, data.frame(imp = i, cutpoint = cutpoint_i))
}





```




```{r}
final_cohort_aces<-final_cohort%>%
  inner_join(all_scores,by=(c("hhidpn","imp")))%>%
  inner_join(cutpoint_df,by="imp")%>%
  mutate(cutpoint_ace = ifelse(aces > cutpoint, 1, 0))
```
